review_candidates.title: Sales & account manager
review_candidates.description: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Shape the B2B sales function. Joining a fast-moving team building a world-class B2B sales function, you’ll help define the strategy, approach, and guiding principles that set a new standard for excellence in enterprise sales. Curate high-potential leads. Build a portfolio of revenue-driving corporate clients, leveraging the latest AI tools to prioritize where you invest your time for long-term growth. Learn the industry inside and out. Understand the incentives, pressure points, and decision-makers of your industry so you can build powerful, profitable relationships. Be a credible voice for the product. Speak about it with clarity and confidence. Gather feedback from clients and share insights to help shape future development. Follow the data. Keep a close eye on performance metrics to gauge impact and zero in on the highest-value actions and opportunities. Stand out at every touchpoint. Deliver outstanding service that builds trust with every client interaction. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £68,579 to £112,189 in London and from €54,346 to €82,557 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries. The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

review_candidates.title: Project Director - DRC Digital Health Worker Registration System
review_candidates.location: Kinshasa, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
review_candidates.description: Program: Implementing a Digital Health Worker Information System ( iHRIS ) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo ( DRC) Location: Kinshasa, DRC (full-time, in-country) Reports to: Sr. Program Manager (GST) Duration: 36 months Please Note: This position is contingent upon award and donor approval. Start date will be determined upon award. Overview Global Communities champions community-led solutions to complex challenges at the intersection of global health, humanitarian assistance, sustainable development, and financial inclusion. Together with our subsidiary IntraHealth International, we bring local and global insights together to save lives, expand opportunity , and build resilient health systems. We are the developer and global steward of iHRIS , the only free, open-source Human Resource Information System, used in more than 30 countries to manage over two million health worker records . Global Communities is seeking a full-time Project Director, based in Kinshasa, DRC, to lead a new project to establish a government-owned, sustainable iHRIS to improve health workforce planning, management, equity, and payment integrity in the DRC. The project will support the Ministry of Public Health, Hygiene, and Social Welfare (MoH), the Agence Nationale d’Ingénierie Clinique (ANICNS), and other government stakeholders to design, implement, and institutionalize iHRIS in two provinces, interoperable with the national health worker payment system, as a model for scaling nationwide. The Project Director will oversee all elements of the project, including providing strategic leadership and vision, guiding technical direction, ensuring financial and operational oversight, managing and mentoring the in-country team, and navigating a complex, multi-stakeholder political environment. Success requires strong political acumen, deep experience in health systems strengthening in the DRC, and the ability to build consensus across ministries, donors, and provincial authorities. Responsibilities The Project Director is responsible for overall program implementation, strategic vision, and outcome achievement. The Project Director provides an integrated vision for the project and leads a team of senior staff and consultants to ensure the quality, timeliness, and efficiency of all products and activities. Specific responsibilities include the following: Strategic Leadership & Program Direction Provide overall project leadership, strategic vision, and day-to-day direction, overseeing all technical, operational, and administrative elements of the project. Lead the co-design and co-creation process with government and other stakeholders to define system requirements, governance arrangements, and an iHRIS roadmap aligned with the MoH strategies. Apply adaptive, people-centered management and scaling approaches to build the conditions for sustainability and scale from day one. Supervise, mentor, and manage the in-country team, including the Software Development Engineer, Capacity Strengthening Officer, and Finance & Administration Manager, and coordinate global technical support. Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management Serve as the senior in-country representative for the project, building and sustaining strong relationships with the MoH, ANICNS, Ministère de la Fonction Publique, Ministries of Budget and Finance, provincial health authorities, the Central Bank, and other stakeholders. Oversee effective stakeholder engagement and change management, navigating a politically complex environment to build consensus, secure political backing, and drive sustained adoption of iHRIS . Convene and maintain a cross-government coordination structure and support the establishment of governance arrangements, MoUs , and accountability mechanisms across national and provincial levels. Coordinate with other key stakeholders, including donors, multi-lateral organizations, and other implementing partners. Technical Oversight Support the review of human resources for health (HR H) an d human resourc es m anagement (H RM) policies and the implementation of consistent, transparent, and gender- equita ble HRM practices across different levels of the health system. Build local capacity to use HRH data for decision-making and embed data use into routine HR practices, including workforce planning, deployment, supervision, gender analysis, equity, retention, and payment oversight. Oversee high-quality, evidence-based implementation across all project outcomes— assessment and co-creation, government accountability for iHRIS use, software development and payments interoperability, provincial implementation, and transition to scale. Ensure activities are aligned with national guidelines, WHO guidance, and donor requirements. Operational & Financial Management Lead regular workplan, budget, and implementation reviews to ensure cost-effective and timely achievement of milestones, deliverables, and targets. Provide effective oversight of project operations, procurement, and partner management to ensure compliance and strong performance. Ensure sound financial management, documentation, and internal controls consistent with donor requirements and Global Communities policies. Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning & Sustainability Support sustainability planning, including domestic financing, government ownership, hosting, and a structured transition of iHRIS operations to government stakeholders. Lead the project learning agenda, overseeing timely technical and financial reporting and ensuring accurate documentation of progress, achievements, and challenges. Capture lessons learned and translate evidence into actionable strategies, knowledge products, and recommendations to inform national scale-up and dissemination. Qualifications Minimum qualifications Master’s degree or above in public health, health systems, human resources, international development, or a related field. Demonstrated track record of leading projects of similar size, scope, and complexity, with strong strategic visioning and leadership capabilities. Expertise in health workforce management, human resources for health planning and data use. Experience in health systems strengthening in the DRC. Strong political acumen and demonstrated experience navigating complex systems, building consensus, and engaging government and donor stakeholders in the DRC. Skills in people-centered, adaptive management and supervision, with the ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams and drive results under deadlines. Fluency in French and English. Must have strong working proficiency in English (written and oral). Preferred Qualifications Experience implementing or managing health workforce information systems (e.g., iHRIS ) or digital health / health information systems. Familiarity with health worker information systems, digital public infrastructure, and interoperability. Experience integrating gender equity into health workforce programming. Established relationships with the DRC government stakeholders. Global Communities’ Commitment Global Communities positively welcomes and seeks applications from all sections of society. review_candidates.title: Junior accountmanager
review_candidates.description: Jij wilt geen standaard commerciële functie. Je wilt weten wat er speelt in de markt, kansen herkennen en daar commercieel op inspelen. Je wilt jezelf ontwikkelen in accountmanagement, klantcontact en onderhandelen en tegelijkertijd leren hoe de markt van metaalrecycling werkt. Als junior accountmanager bij Myne krijg je de verantwoordelijkheid over een eigen klantenportefeuille in Nederland. Je spreekt met lokale en regionale schroothandelaren, volgt de markt op de voet en leert steeds beter wat er beschikbaar is en tegen welke prijs. Van het eerste telefoontje tot de levering van het materiaal: jij bent betrokken bij de hele klantreis. Ben jij een ondernemende starter die energie krijgt van klantcontact, onderhandelen, dynamiek en verantwoordelijkheid? Wil je veel leren, jezelf ontwikkelen en stap voor stap steeds meer commerciële verantwoordelijkheid pakken? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Over Myne Bij Myne bouwen we aan de toekomst van de metaalindustrie. Wij geloven in een wereld waarin metalen oneindig worden gerecycled en grondstoffen nooit verloren gaan. Met onze innovatieve Xorter-technologie, ontwikkeld in samenwerking met de Technische Universiteit Delft, maken we hoogwaardige metaalrecycling mogelijk en dragen we iedere dag bij aan een circulaire economie. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Harderwijk werken ruim 75 enthousiaste collega's aan één gezamenlijke missie: de recyclingindustrie slimmer, duurzamer en innovatiever maken. Onze business groeit en we bewegen ons in een markt die continu in ontwikkeling is. Daarom zoeken we een junior accountmanager die kansen ziet, relaties wil opbouwen en zich wil ontwikkelen tot een sterke commerciële professional binnen de Nederlandse markt. Wat ga je doen als junior accountmanager? Als junior accountmanager krijg je een eigen klantenportefeuille met voornamelijk bestaande en warme relaties. Je leert hoe je deze klanten goed bedient, relaties verder uitbouwt en commerciële kansen herkent. Daarbij krijg je vanaf het begin verantwoordelijkheid, maar sta je er niet alleen voor: ervaren collega's helpen je om de markt, materialen en commerciële afwegingen steeds beter te begrijpen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Relatiebeheer: je onderhoudt actief contact met klanten via persoonlijke bezoeken, telefoon en WhatsApp. Je leert wat klanten belangrijk vinden en hoe je een relatie verder uitbouwt. Inkoop & onderhandelen: je koopt metaalstromen in, zoals koper, aluminium, messing en elektromotoren. Je leert onderhandelen over prijs, volume en voorwaarden en werkt daarbij binnen duidelijke commerciële kaders. Marktkennis: je volgt dagelijks marktontwikkelingen en prijzen en bouwt stap voor stap kennis op van materialen, leveranciers en beschikbare volumes. Commerciële kansen: je leert kansen bij bestaande klanten herkennen en benutten en krijgt steeds meer ruimte om zelf nieuwe contacten te ontwikkelen. De volledige klantreis: je bent betrokken van het eerste klantcontact en de prijsbepaling tot de levering en afwikkeling. Naarmate je groeit, neem je hierin steeds meer zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid. Je werkt samen in een commercieel team van 12 collega's, verdeeld over de Nederlandse, Duitse, Belgische en Franse markt. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, maar kunt altijd terugvallen op ervaren collega's. Naarmate je meer ervaring en kennis opdoet, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid over je klantenportefeuille en commerciële kansen. Jouw initiatief, commerciële inzicht en vermogen om snel te leren en te schakelen maken het verschil. Wie ben jij? Je bent een ondernemende en commercieel gedreven starter die makkelijk contact maakt en graag kansen benut. Je hoeft nog niet alles te kunnen: we vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je nieuwsgierig bent, initiatief neemt en jezelf graag wilt ontwikkelen. Je vindt het leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te krijgen, maar staat ook open voor begeleiding en feedback. Daarnaast heb je: Een afgeronde bacheloropleiding. 1 tot 2 jaar werkervaring in accountmanagement, sales of een commerciële handelsomgeving. Ervaring met klantcontact en het vermogen om gemakkelijk nieuwe contacten te leggen. Een proactieve en resultaatgerichte houding. Een commerciële instelling en interesse in wat er in de markt gebeurt. Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Duits is een plus. Interesse in duurzaamheid en de toekomst van de metaalindustrie. Ervaring in de handel, recycling of metaalindustrie? Dat is mooi meegenomen, maar geen must. Materiaalkennis hoef je nog niet te hebben. Belangrijker vinden we dat je gemotiveerd bent, commercieel inzicht hebt en het leuk vindt om je de markt en onze materialen eigen te maken. Waarom werken bij Myne? Als Junior Accountmanager Krijg Je Bij Myne De Ruimte Om Jezelf Te Ontwikkelen, Een Netwerk Op Te Bouwen En Stap Voor Stap Steeds Meer Commerciële Verantwoordelijkheid Te Nemen. Dat Betekent Een salaris van € 3.000 tot € 4.000 bruto per maand, passend bij jouw ervaring. 8% vakantiegeld en 25 vakantiedagen Een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van performance. Een goede bedrijfspensioenregeling. Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken. Veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Een open en transparante organisatie met korte lijnen en een informele werksfeer. Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Regelmatige sociale activiteiten en een sportprogramma. Werken aan een duurzame missie die impact maakt. Klaar om als junior accountmanager impact te maken? Solliciteer vandaag nog. We zijn benieuwd naar jouw commerciële drive én hoe jij je als junior accountmanager verder wilt ontwikkelen en kansen gaat benutten voor Myne. Nadat je gesolliciteerd hebt, wordt er binnen 2 dagen contact met je opgenomen. Tijdens een eerste gesprek maak je kennis met Thomas en Koos. We zijn benieuwd naar jou, je ervaring en vooral naar hoe jij denkt en waarom je graag bij onze organisatie zou willen werken. Is er van beide kanten een klik? Dan volgt een tweede gesprek met een van je toekomstige collega's uit het commerciële team. Daarna maak je online een persoonlijkheidstest. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan verwelkomen we je graag als onze nieuwe junior accountmanager. Heb je vragen over de vacature? Neem gerust contact op met onze recruiter Sonja via recruitment@myne.eco of bel/app naar 06-83544687.
